environment.description: Same Flask application deployed behind CloudFront distribution with Lambda@Edge viewer-response function (ARN: arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:XXXX:function:sec-headers-v3) that appends response headers. The function adds a Strict-Transport-Security header and a content-security-policy header. The CSP directive string is assembled from a DynamoDB configuration table (table: 'csp-directives-prod') which currently resolves to: default-src 'self'; script-src 'nonce-{per-request-random}'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'. The nonce is generated per-request by the Lambda@Edge function and is NOT available to the application code. CloudFront cache behavior has 'Managed-SecurityHeadersPolicy' attached as a fallback but the Lambda@Edge takes precedence for the script-src directive.

config.lambda_edge: viewer-response trigger, adds CSP with per-request nonce
config.nonce_generation: crypto.randomBytes(16) in Lambda@Edge, not shared with origin
